notes: spec_copy is copied verbatim from the case creation spec 3.2.0 (question_copy, pre_question_copy, each use case's copy, voice_samples) and the Support and Crisis Plan 3.2.0 follow-up. Tests fail if it drifts.
Break screens, the rest offer, and the rest clock notes moved to take-a-break-copy.json with the take a break spec 3.2.0.
flow_copy is quoted verbatim from the specs' flows and rules (button, label, and heading text).
draft_copy was written for the build because the specs don't supply it. It needs product, legal, and clinical review before launch.
Keys in legal_review_keys hold price, subscription, or legal-authority wording. They need counsel approval before launch ([LEGAL] UC-CASE-12, card 55).
draft_notice says 28 days. If app_settings.draft_retention_days changes, change it too.
Placeholders in braces are filled by the API: {display_name}, {trial_end_date}, {email}, {channels}, {frequency}, {days}, {tasks}, {path_title}, {step}.
Web browser only for the alpha (DEC-PLAT): select, never tap. Browser notifications, never phone notifications.

spec_copy.question_user_role: What is your connection to them?
spec_copy.question_display_name: What would you like me to call them?
spec_copy.question_circumstance: Had they been ill, or was it sudden?
spec_copy.question_veteran_status: Did they ever serve in the military?
spec_copy.question_estate_plan_status: Did they have a will or estate plan?
spec_copy.question_completed_items: Has anything already been taken care of? Select anything that's done. It's fine if nothing is.
spec_copy.pre_question_circumstance: This helps me know which steps to show you. You don't need to share details.
spec_copy.intro: I'll ask a few gentle questions so I can show you the steps that fit. You can skip anything, and you can stop and come back whenever you need.
spec_copy.poa_authority_note: A power of attorney usually ends when the person dies. After a death, the person named in the will as executor, or someone appointed by the court, usually takes over. An estate attorney can tell you what applies where you live.
spec_copy.place_unknown: When you know where it happened, I can find the right office.
spec_copy.level_2_after_skips: We don't have to do all of this today. Would you like to rest for now, do one small thing, or just talk for a minute?
spec_copy.pre_button_notice: When you select Start journey, your 28 free days begin. They keep counting if you pause, unless Cairn suggests a rest because things have become too much. You won't need to enter any payment information now. Once you subscribe, a break never pauses or changes your subscription.
spec_copy.confirmation_first_case: Your journey has started. Your 28 free days begin today and end on {trial_end_date}. You don't need to enter any payment information now. When your 28 days are up, we'll ask whether you'd like to subscribe. A subscription is $14.99 a month and covers all your cases. Taking a break doesn't pause a subscription. If you don't subscribe, nothing is charged, and your account becomes read-only. Nothing is deleted. A week before your free time ends, you'll see a reminder here in Cairn, and we'll also email it to {email}.
spec_copy.not_today: That's okay. Everything is saved, and we'll start right here when you come back. Your free days keep counting while you're away.
spec_copy.steady_care_example: We can set all of this aside. I'm here. You don't have to do anything right now.
spec_copy.redaction_explanation: You don't need to share that right now. I've removed it to keep it safe. If a step needs it later, I'll tell you exactly who needs it.
spec_copy.draft_notice: I've saved this for you. If it isn't opened for 28 days, it will be deleted automatically to protect your privacy. Opening it any time keeps it safe.
spec_copy.confirmation_existing_trial: Your journey has started. Your free days still end on {trial_end_date}. You don't need to enter any payment information now.
spec_copy.confirmation_subscribed: Your journey has started. It's included in your subscription.
spec_copy.notifications_intro: Here's how I'll keep in touch: {channels}, {frequency}. You can change this any time.
spec_copy.notification_example: You have a step coming up in Cairn.
spec_copy.speech_first_use: You can talk instead of typing. I turn what you say into words on the screen, and I don't keep the recording.
spec_copy.ai_reminder: A quick reminder: I'm Cairn, an AI guide. I'm a computer program, not a person.
spec_copy.under_18_message: I'm so sorry about your loss. Cairn is made for adults, so I can't set this up with you. A trusted adult, like a family member, a school counselor, or a coach, can help with these steps, and they can use Cairn. If you want to talk to someone right now, you can call or text 988 any time.
spec_copy.circumstance_question_steady_direct: This next question helps me show the right steps. You don't need to share details. Was the death expected, or was it sudden?
spec_copy.circumstance_question_warm_patient: Take whatever time you need with this one. It helps me to know a little about how it happened, only in general terms. Had they been ill, or was it sudden? You can also skip this.
spec_copy.circumstance_question_brisk_businesslike: One question that changes the plan: was this expected or sudden? A general answer is enough.
spec_copy.circumstance_question_plain_practical: Whether a death was expected or sudden changes who signs the death certificate and how long it can take. Which was it? You can skip this.
spec_copy.circumstance_question_steady_care: We can set all of this aside. I'm here. You don't have to do anything right now.
spec_copy.notifications_question_steady_direct: I can let you know when something is due. How would you like to hear from me? You can also choose to hear from me only when you open Cairn.
spec_copy.notifications_question_warm_patient: Some people like a gentle nudge, and some would rather not hear from anyone for a while. Both are fine. How would you like me to keep in touch, if at all?
spec_copy.notifications_question_brisk_businesslik: Notifications: email, text, browser notifications, or none. Which do you want?
spec_copy.notifications_question_plain_practical: I can tell you when something is due. I won't send anything you don't choose. How should I reach you, if at all?
spec_copy.check_in_question: Would it be okay if I checked in with you tomorrow?
spec_copy.check_in_outside_cairn: Checking in, as you asked. There's nothing you need to do today.
spec_copy.check_in_in_cairn: Checking in, as you asked. There's nothing you need to do today. If it would help to talk with someone, you can call or text 988 any time.
spec_copy.ask_about_suicide: Are you thinking about ending your life?
spec_copy.lead_time_question: How early would you like to hear about something that's due?
spec_copy.inactivity_question: If it's been a while since you opened Cairn, would you like me to check in?
spec_copy.empty_state: When you're ready, we can start with the person who died. Your 28 free days won't start until you start a journey.

flow_copy.figure_out_later: What we can figure out later
flow_copy.one_question_at_a_time: Answer one question at a time
flow_copy.own_words: Tell me in your own words
flow_copy.probably_not_applicable_label: Probably doesn't apply. Select it if it does.
flow_copy.talk_to_someone: I would like to talk to someone
flow_copy.change_how_you_hear: Change how you hear from me

draft_copy.ack_first_case: I'm so sorry for your loss. I'm here to help with the practical steps, at your pace.
draft_copy.ack_another_case: I'm so sorry you're facing another loss. We can take this one at its own pace too.
draft_copy.intake_mode_question: Would you like me to ask one question at a time, or would you rather tell me in your own words?
draft_copy.own_words_prompt: Share whatever you'd like, in your own words. I'll pick out what helps and read it back to you.
draft_copy.readback_nothing: Thank you for telling me. I didn't pick up any of the details I use to build the steps, and that's okay.
draft_copy.readback_fix: Of course. Tell me what to change, or answer the questions one at a time.
draft_copy.answer_skipped: That's fine. We can come back to it whenever you like.
draft_copy.answer_unsure: That's okay. We can figure it out later.
draft_copy.display_name_ack: Thank you. I'll call them {display_name} from here on.
draft_copy.circumstance_confirmed: Thank you. That helps me show the right steps.
draft_copy.volunteered_cause_ack: Thank you for telling me. You don't need to share more than you want to.
draft_copy.loss_survivor_offer: If it would ever help, there are people who support families after a suicide loss. You can find them at afsp.org whenever you want.
draft_copy.step_added: I've added a step to your journey: {tasks}.
draft_copy.veterans_crisis_line_added: I've also added the Veterans Crisis Line to your support resources.
draft_copy.no_will_reassure: That's very common, and it doesn't mean things will go badly. I've added a step that explains what happens next.
draft_copy.family_disagreement_ack: That sounds really hard. I won't take sides, and I can't help settle it. An estate attorney can, so I've added that as a step.
draft_copy.attorney_task_added: This is a time to talk to an estate attorney. I've added that as a step, and I'll keep showing you everything else I can help with.
draft_copy.attorney_referral_line: Cairn can't give legal advice and isn't a substitute for an attorney. An estate attorney can tell you what applies in your state.
draft_copy.outside_us_ack: Thank you for telling me. Cairn doesn't cover deaths outside the United States yet, and I'm sorry I can't guide you through it. Your case is saved. The funeral home, and an attorney who handles international matters, are good places to start.
draft_copy.outside_us_not_covered: Cairn doesn't cover deaths outside the United States yet. The funeral home and an attorney can help with the steps that apply.
draft_copy.certificate_may_be_pending_note: When a medical examiner or coroner is involved, the death certificate may first show the cause as pending. Some offices and companies accept a pending certificate, and some wait for the final one.
draft_copy.fiduciary_offer: I can keep a shorter pace and leave out the explainers.
draft_copy.name_fallback_offer: If you'd rather, I can say the person who died.
draft_copy.name_fallback_question: Which would you like me to use?
draft_copy.changed_probably_not_applicable: I marked {tasks} as probably not needed. They're still there.
draft_copy.resume_where: Last time we were talking about {step}.
draft_copy.resume_start: We hadn't started the questions yet.
draft_copy.resume_done: You'd answered everything you wanted to.
draft_copy.all_questions_done: That's everything I need for now.
draft_copy.journey_preview_intro: Here are the first four weeks. Nothing here is due today.
draft_copy.not_yet_saved: That's fine. Everything you've shared is saved.
draft_copy.pre_button_notice_existing_trial: Starting this journey doesn't change your free days. They still end on {trial_end_date}. You won't need to enter any payment information now.
draft_copy.death_not_yet_ack: Thank you for telling me. I'm so sorry you're going through this.
draft_copy.death_not_yet_explain: Cairn's journeys start after a death. You can save what you've shared now, or come back whenever you need to.
draft_copy.time_sensitive_intro: These are the most time-sensitive right now.
draft_copy.small_task_open: Take your time. There's nothing else you need to do today.
draft_copy.support_988: You can call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, any time.
draft_copy.support_veterans_crisis_line: Veterans and their families can reach the Veterans Crisis Line by dialing 988 and pressing 1, or by texting 838255.
draft_copy.risk_ack: I'm really glad you told me. Your safety matters more than any of this.
draft_copy.emergency_911: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 911.
draft_copy.safety_next: Whenever you're ready, and only if you want to, we can pick this back up.
draft_copy.path_expected_loss_why: Because they had been ill, this starts with the steps that usually follow an expected death.
draft_copy.path_sudden_loss_why: Because the death was sudden, this allows for a death certificate that may take a little longer.
draft_copy.path_sudden_loss_investigation_title: a sudden loss that may be reviewed
draft_copy.path_sudden_loss_investigation_why: Because a medical examiner or coroner may be involved, this starts with what their review means for you.
draft_copy.path_general_why: This covers the steps most families need in the first four weeks. It will adjust as you add details.
draft_copy.label_circumstance_expected_illness_or_h: They had been ill, or were in hospice
draft_copy.label_estate_plan_status_yes_location_kn: Yes, and I know where it is
draft_copy.label_estate_plan_status_yes_location_un: Yes, but I'm not sure where it is
draft_copy.label_completed_items_funeral_home_has_s: The funeral home has their Social Security number
draft_copy.label_completed_items_none_or_unsure: Nothing yet, or I'm not sure
draft_copy.notifications_sms_not_available: Cairn can't send text messages yet. You can choose email, browser notifications, or only inside Cairn.
draft_copy.change_notifications: Change how Cairn keeps in touch
draft_copy.case_deletion_explanation: Deleting this case removes everything in it: your answers, the journey and its tasks, and your conversations about it. Your account and any other cases stay.
draft_copy.case_deletion_question: Would you like to delete it now, or in 7 days?
draft_copy.case_deletion_confirmation_destination: We'll send one confirmation to {masked_email} once it's deleted.
draft_copy.case_deletion_scheduled: This case will be deleted on {date}. Until then, you can keep it if you change your mind.
draft_copy.case_deletion_cancelled: This case is staying. Nothing was deleted.
draft_copy.small_task_example: Write down who you've already called.
draft_copy.label_completed_items_home_pets_vehicles: Their home, pets, and car are safe
draft_copy.label_completed_items_bank_insurer_or_em: A bank, insurer, or employer knows
draft_copy.handled_by_prompt: Who is handling it? You can leave this blank.
draft_copy.dmv_where_they_lived: When you know where they lived, I can find the right motor vehicle office.
draft_copy.support_crisis_text_line: You can also text HOME to 741741 to reach the Crisis Text Line.
draft_copy.support_grief: 988 is there for grief and any hard feelings, not only a crisis. You can talk with a person any time.
draft_copy.support_afsp_loss_survivors: Support for people who have lost someone to suicide is at afsp.org.
draft_copy.level_2_signals: This is a lot, so I'll stop the questions for now. Would you like to rest for now, do one small thing, or just talk for a minute?
draft_copy.just_talk: I'm here. Tell me whatever is on your mind. There are no questions to answer.
draft_copy.pre_button_notice_subscribed: This journey is included in your subscription.
draft_copy.not_today_subscribed: That's okay. Everything is saved, and we'll start right here when you come back.

draft_copy.check_in_no_saved: That's okay. I'm here whenever you want to come back.
